statBlock.name: Guard Captain
statBlock.description: An officer of the watch who fights with a longsword or throws javelins.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Javelin or Longsword for each.
Javelin. Melee or ranged attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Longsword. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Pirate
statBlock.description: A dagger-armed raider who can distract an adversary with a flash of charm.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Dagger attacks. The pirate can use Enthralling Panache in place of one attack.
Dagger. Melee or ranged attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Enthralling Panache. One creature the pirate can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Charmed until the pirate's next turn starts.

statBlock.name: Pirate Captain
statBlock.description: A pirate commander who fights with rapier and pistol and exploits an opening after a parry.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks, choosing Rapier or Pistol for each.
Rapier. Melee attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage and gives the captain Advantage on its next attack roll before the current turn ends.
Pistol. Ranged attack, +7 to hit, range 30/90 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Captain's Charm. One creature the captain can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Charmed until the captain's next turn starts.
sections.Reactions: Riposte. When a melee attack roll hits the captain while it holds a weapon, the captain can add 3 to its AC against that attack. If this turns the hit into a miss, the captain makes one Rapier attack against the attacker if it is within reach.

statBlock.name: Priest Acolyte
statBlock.description: A junior cleric who channels radiant power in combat and can call on divine aid.

sections.Actions:
Mace. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage and 2 (1d4) radiant damage.
Radiant Flame. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft. A hit deals 7 (2d6) radiant damage.
Spellcasting. At will, cast Light or Thaumaturgy with Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.
sections.Bonus actions: Divine Aid (1/Day). Cast one of Bless, Healing Word, or Sanctuary with Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.

statBlock.name: Warrior Infantry
statBlock.description: A spear fighter trained to attack alongside a nearby comrade.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. An attack roll against a creature has Advantage if at least one ally of the attacker is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Spear. Melee or ranged attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Warrior Veteran
statBlock.description: An experienced soldier who wears splint armor and carries a greatsword and heavy crossbow.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow for each.
Greatsword. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged attack, +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d10 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. When a melee attack roll hits the veteran while it holds a weapon, the veteran can add 2 to its AC against that attack, potentially turning the hit into a miss.

statBlock.name: Tough
statBlock.description: An enforcer with a mace and heavy crossbow who fights better with backup.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. An attack roll against a creature has Advantage if at least one ally of the attacker is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Mace. Melee attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged attack, +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Tough Boss
statBlock.description: An armored gang leader who can knock an opponent back with a warhammer.

sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. An attack roll against a creature has Advantage if at least one ally of the attacker is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Warhammer or Heavy Crossbow for each.
Warhammer. Melee attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. The boss can also push a Large or smaller creature up to 10 ft. directly away from itself.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged attack, +4 to hit, range 100/400 ft. A hit deals 13 (2d10 + 2) piercing damage.
